items.text: I've been on a big traditional roguelike/ procgen kick lately and really wanted to like this game. It seems it has so many parts of what I would love in a game but as it is now it's just too clunky. I love the interface when you begin to fly but ultimately it is a drag to actually play. I understand the dev may have a vision for how they want you to play but if we're so far in the future joe shmoe can just get a space ship to become an illegal scrapper, why hasn't someone invented tech to autopilot the ship?
items.text_zh: 我最近特别迷传统 roguelike/程序生成类游戏，真的很想喜欢上这款游戏。它似乎包含了很多我会喜欢一款游戏所具备的元素，但就目前而言，它实在太笨重了。我喜欢刚开始飞行时的界面，但最终实际玩起来还是很拖沓。我理解开发者可能对玩家该怎么玩有自己的设想，但如果我们都已经身处那么遥远的未来，随便一个张三李四都能搞到一艘飞船去当非法拾荒者，那为什么还没人发明出能让飞船自动驾驶的技术呢？

observations.description: 游戏操作笨重，玩起来费劲
